items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: No, I know him well. Gus Faulkner. I met him. We used to meet him. He had the Banner Band.

ctx.x: Lawrence Dewey was playing clarinet. We had a clarinet. We had Robert Gilbert. He was playing a C melody. Then he got an alto after, a little later. And we had a fellow that called Casey on bass. Walter Thomas was the drummer. That was E.Vance's drummer. And we had a guitar player called Kudu. I never did. That's the only name I knew him about was Kudu. He played guitar player. Nice guitar. So then finally...
Was there a trombone fellow by the name of Gus? Did you ever play with him out there?

No, I know him well. Gus Faulkner. I met him. We used to meet him. He had the Banner Band. And the Black Eagle Band and the Banner Band. They were the two best bands around at that time. We used to play in Texas together. We met up all the time.
